assignments.expression:
OtherPartyAccount = x.OtherPartyAccount != null
                    ? new PartyAccount
                    {
                        AccountIdentification = x.OtherPartyAccount.AccountIdentification.ToAccountNumber(),
                        AccountIdentificationDisplay = x.OtherPartyAccount.AccountIdentification.ToAccountNumberDisplay(),
                        AccountIdentificationType = x.OtherPartyAccount.AccountIdentificationType
                    }
                    : null

OtherPartyReference = x.OtherPartyReference != null
                    ? new PartyReference
                    {
                        Particulars = x.OtherPartyReference.Particulars,
                        Code = x.OtherPartyReference.Code,
                        Reference = x.OtherPartyReference.Reference
                    }
                    : null

ThisPartyReference = x.ThisPartyReference != null
                    ? new PartyReference
                    {
                        Particulars = x.ThisPartyReference.Particulars,
                        Code = x.ThisPartyReference.Code,
                        Reference = x.ThisPartyReference.Reference
                    }
                    : null

AccountBalanceInterimBooked =
                    x.AccountBalanceInterimBookedAmount != null &&
                    x.AccountBalanceInterimBookedCurrencyCode != null
                        ? new Money
                        {
                            Value = x.AccountBalanceInterimBookedAmount.ToString() ?? "0",
                            Currency = GetCurrency(x.AccountBalanceInterimBookedCurrencyCode)
                        }
                        : null

TaxDeduction = x.TaxDeduction != null ? new TaxDeduction
            {
                DomesticTaxType = x.TaxDeduction.DomesticTaxType != null ? GetDomesticTaxType(x.TaxDeduction.DomesticTaxType) : null,
                TaxRateValue = x.TaxDeduction.TaxRateValue,
                NominatedTaxPartyId = x.TaxDeduction.NominatedTaxPartyId,
                NonResidentWithholdingTaxCountryAlpha3Code = x.TaxDeduction.NonResidentWithholdingTaxCountryAlpha3Code
            } : null

Posting_instruction_batch = new PostingInstructionBatchEvent
            {
                Id = batch.Id,
                Create_request_id = batch.CreateRequestId,
                Client_id = batch.ClientId,
                Client_batch_id = batch.ClientBatchId,
                Status = batch.Status,
                Value_timestamp = ToDateTimeOffset(batch.ValueTimestamp),
                Booking_timestamp = ToDateTimeOffset(batch.BookingTimestamp),
                Insertion_timestamp = ToDateTimeOffset(batch.InsertionTimestamp) ?? default,
                Dry_run = batch.DryRun,
                Batch_details = ToBatchDetails(batch.BatchDetails),
                Posting_instructions = batch.PostingInstructions
                    .Select(ToPostingInstruction)
                    .ToList()
            }

AccountAddressBalances = ledgerBalances.Select(x =>
                    new AsyncAPI.AccountAddressBalances
                    {
                        TotalDebit = x.Total_debit,
                        TotalCredit = x.Total_credit,
                        NetBalance = x.Amount,
                        AccountAssetType = x.Asset,
                        AccountAddressName = x.Account_address,
                        AccountAddressBalanceDateTime = accountBalanceDateTime,
                        AccountAddressBalanceCurrencyCode = x.Denomination,
                        AccountAddressBalancePhase =
                            x.Phase.ToAccountAddressBalancesAccountBalancePhase()
                    })
                .ToList()

ThisPartyReference = new PartyReference
            {
                Particulars = isCredit
                    ? balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.CreditorParticular
                    : balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.DebtorParticular,
                Code = isCredit
                    ? balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.CreditorCode
                    : balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.DebtorCode,
                Reference = isCredit
                    ? balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.CreditorReference
                    : balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.DebtorReference
            }

OtherPartyReference = new PartyReference
            {
                Particulars = isCredit
                    ? balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.DebtorParticular
                    : balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.CreditorParticular,
                Code = isCredit
                    ? balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.DebtorCode
                    : balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.CreditorCode,
                Reference = isCredit
                    ? balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.DebtorReference
                    : balanceEntry.InstructionDetails.CreditorReference
            }
